Richard,

Can you let me know what make and model of phone you are using?

Do you also have background sync set to 'Always' in Settings > General Settings > Network?

We are having some issues with message sync that we're working on improving, but I want to help check these issues as well, to make sure this issue isn't caused by something we can easily fixed!
